justifications.A: The harness reports lint, typecheck, test_js and phpcs all as pass.
justifications.B: A `{ title: 'Tile all windows', url: '', onSelect: () => manager.tile() }` row is added to the System rows, and the updated comment `(Fullscreen, Tile all windows, Log out)` confirms its order; `pickGridDimensions` now returns `n <= 3 ? n` columns, so three windows go in thirds, two in halves and four in 2×2.
justifications.C: The row calls the existing `manager.tile()`, and only the grid rule in `geometry.ts` and the row spans in `arrange.ts` were changed, still through `shareRowByMinWidth` and the work-area rect.
justifications.D: No `assets/js/` edits, no raw fetch/confirm/alert, no `:host` tokens, no `@since` or version stamps, and no new ESLint disables appear in the diff.
justifications.E: Two cases were added to the existing `tests/vitest/arrange.test.ts`: 'three windows in thirds on one row' with exact pixel geometry, and the five-window short-row case, which cover the changed grid rule.
justifications.F: `docs/javascript-reference.md` now says `tile()` is the System menu's **Tile all windows** row, keeps the 'no UI' claim only for `cascade()`/`setSnapEnabled()`, and describes the new grid rule.
justifications.G: Changes are limited to the menu row, the grid picker, the row-span logic, one test file and one doc paragraph; the only extra churn is a rewrapped header comment in `arrange.ts`.
justifications.H: The final message says it ran `npm run build`, `lint`, `typecheck` and `test:js` (6616 tests passing), which matches the passing gates.

notable: Fixing the three-window case in `pickGridDimensions` with a simple, documented rule, backed by an exact-geometry test, is the main strength. The rewrite does drop the old 6×6 cap, and it also changes the Tile layout used by workspaces, a side effect the agent disclosed openly.
